_help: Advisor agreement template. Fields become the form; {{key}} in the text is replaced with what the visitor types. Blank fields show as [Field label]. A plain starting point only: it must be reviewed by a qualified lawyer.
title: Advisor Agreement

fields.label: What the advisor will help with
fields.placeholder: Tokenomics review, exchange introductions, one call a month

fields.label: Payment
fields.placeholder: 0.25% of token supply, or USD 1,000 a month

fields.label: Vesting of the payment
fields.placeholder: 3 month cliff, then monthly over 12 months

fields.label: Governing law
fields.placeholder: Laws of your country or state

fields.label: Signing for the company (name and title)

sections.title: Parties
text: This Advisor Agreement (the "Agreement") is made on {{date}} between {{company}}, of {{companyAddress}} (the "Company"), and {{advisor}}, of {{advisorAddress}} (the "Advisor").

sections.title: 1. Services
text: The Advisor will help the Company with: {{services}}.
The Advisor expects to spend {{hours}}. The Advisor is free to choose how to do the work.

sections.title: 2. Length
text: This Agreement starts on the date above and lasts {{term}}, unless it ends earlier under section 6.

sections.title: 3. Payment and vesting
text: For the services, the Company will pay the Advisor: {{pay}}.
Any tokens or equity vest as follows: {{vesting}}. Anything not vested when this Agreement ends is cancelled.
The Company will repay reasonable costs the Advisor has agreed in writing beforehand.

sections.title: 4. Independent advisor
text: The Advisor is an independent contractor, not an employee, partner or agent of the Company, and cannot sign anything for the Company.
The Advisor pays their own taxes.

sections.title: 5. Confidential information and work
text: The Advisor will keep the Company's non-public information secret during and after this Agreement, and use it only for the services.
Work the Advisor creates for the Company under this Agreement belongs to the Company.

sections.title: 6. Ending the agreement
text: Either party may end this Agreement with {{notice}}. Vesting stops on the end date.

sections.title: 7. Public statements
text: If the Advisor talks about the Company or its token in public, the Advisor will say they are an advisor and are paid by the Company, and will not promise prices or returns.

sections.title: 8. Conflicts
text: The Advisor will tell the Company about any work for a competing project, and will not trade the Company's token using non-public information.

sections.title: 9. Governing law
text: This Agreement is governed by the {{law}}.

sections.title: 10. Whole agreement
text: This Agreement is the whole agreement between the parties. Any change must be in writing and signed by both parties.
